correction_meta.issue: Original Phase 7 R7 block was not persisted to disk and the underlying DM implementation had an inverted sign convention.
correction_meta.fix: Corrected phase7_robustness_v9._stats.dm_winner_vs_baseline_by_fold to call diebold_mariano(-baseline_perf, -winner_perf, alternative='greater') so a positive statistic means the winner outperforms the baseline in per-fold net PnL.
correction_meta.notes_on_spa_wrc: SPA/WRC over execution-delay variants was ORIGINALLY intended to operate on per-fold PnLs from delay-shifted replays. Those replays were not persisted to disk during the original Phase 7 run and cannot be recomputed under the current 'no replay' constraint. SPA/WRC values quoted in the original Phase 7 prose are unverified; the corrected report marks them as UNAVAILABLE and defers their recomputation to a future Phase 7 refresh that persists the delay-shifted per-fold PnLs before writing the stats block.
